						set

	args = [selectedNodeID]
	nodeDescription = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(nodeDescriptionQuery, args, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.openDock('EditTreeDock', params = {'selectedNodeID': selectedNodeID, 'upperLevelName': nodeDescription, 'function': 'add', 'levelName': None})

onChange.script:
if previousValue is not None and currentValue.value != previousValue.value:
		selectQuery = '''
					SELECT 
					    (
					        SELECT
					            ProcessParameterID,
					            AssetID,
					            Description,
					            DefaultValue,
					            --DefaultHigh,
					            --DefaultLow,
					            --DefaultHighHigh,
					            --DefaultLowLow,
					            CAST(ABS(DefaultLowLow - DefaultValue) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) DefaultLowLow,
					            CAST(ABS(DefaultLow - DefaultValue) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) DefaultLow,
					            CAST(ABS(DefaultHigh - DefaultValue) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) DefaultHigh,
					            CAST(ABS(DefaultHighHigh - DefaultValue) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) DefaultHighHigh,
					            Unit
					        FROM ProcessParameters
					        WHERE ProcessParameterID = ?
					        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER
					    ) AS json;
					'''
		
		data = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(selectQuery, [currentValue.value], database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
		data = system.util.jsonDecode(data)
		
		if data is None:
			data = {
				  "DefaultValue": None,
				  "DefaultLowLow": None,
				  "Description": None,
				  "DefaultLow": None,
				  "DefaultHighHigh": None,
				  "DefaultHigh": None,
				  "ProcessParameterID": None,
				  "AssetID": None
				}
		self.view.getChild("root").custom.newParamData = data

config.script:
selectedTreeData = self.view.getChild("root").custom.selectedTreeData
	newParamData = self.view.getChild("root").custom.newParamData
	
#	# Get margins relative to setpoint
	highAlarmMargin = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Params").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Margins").getChild("HighAlarm").props.params.value
	highWarnMargin = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Params").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Margins").getChild("HighWarn").props.params.value
	setpoint = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Params").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Margins").getChild("Setpoint").props.params.value
	lowWarnMargin = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Params").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Margins").getChild("LowWarn").props.params.value
	lowAlarmMargin = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Params").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Margins").getChild("LowAlarm").props.params.value
	
#	# Get absolute values to store in DB
	inputHighAlarm = setpoint + highAlarmMargin
	inputHighWarn = setpoint + highWarnMargin
	inputSetpoint = setpoint
	inputLowWarn = setpoint - lowWarnMargin
	inputLowAlarm = setpoint - lowAlarmMargin
	username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	
#	# for existing param, update values
	if selectedTreeData.ParameterValueID is not None:
		selectedID = selectedTreeData.ParameterValueID
		
		updateQuery = '''update 
							ProcessParameterValues
						set
							[HighHigh] = ?,
							[High] = ?,
							[Value] = ?,
							[Low] = ?,
							[LowLow] = ?,
							[Modified] = getDate(),
							[ModifiedBy] = ?
						where
							[ProcessParameterValueID] = ?'''
		updateArgs = [inputHighAlarm, inputHighWarn, inputSetpoint, inputLowWarn, inputLowAlarm, username, selectedID]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(updateQuery, updateArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
#	# For new params, insert values
	if selectedTreeData.NodeID is not None and newParamData.ProcessParameterID is not None:
		selectedNodeID = selectedTreeData.NodeID
		processParameterID = newParamData.ProcessParameterID
		
		insertQuery = '''insert into ProcessParameterValues
							([RecipeElementID]
							,[ProcessParameterID]
							,[Value]
							,[High]
							,[Low]
							,[HighHigh]
							,[LowLow]
							,[ModifiedBy]
							,[Created])
						values
							(?
							,?
							,?
							,?
							,?
							,?
							,?
							,?
							,getdate())'''
		insertArgs = [selectedNodeID, processParameterID, inputSetpoint, inputHighWarn, inputLowWarn, inputHighAlarm, inputLowAlarm, username]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertQuery, insertArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshArticleManagement')

selectedID = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0].ProcessParameterID
	
	deleteQuery = '''update ProcessParameters set active = 0 where processparameterID = ?'''
	deleteArgs = [selectedID]
	
	system.db.runPrepUpdate(deleteQuery, deleteArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	self.props.value = 0
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshParameters')

selectionData = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0]
	
	dataJSON = {"parameterName": selectionData.Description,
			"assetID": selectionData.AssetID,
			"unit": selectionData.Unit,
			"defaultSetpoint": selectionData.DefaultValue,
			"defaultLowLow": selectionData.DefaultLowLow,
			"defaultLow": selectionData.DefaultLow,
			"defaultHigh": selectionData.DefaultHigh,
			"defaultHighHigh": selectionData.DefaultHighHigh,
			"parameterID": selectionData.ProcessParameterID,
			"lineID": selectionData.lineID,
			"tagPath": selectionData.tagPath}
	
	system.perspective.openDock('ParameterDock', params = {'data': dataJSON})

selectedRow = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0]
	articleID = selectedRow.ArticleID
	
	deleteQuery = '''update Articles set active = 0 where ArticleID = ?'''
	deleteArgs = [articleID]
	
	system.db.runPrepUpdate(deleteQuery, deleteArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshArticles')
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshArticleManagement')
	
	self.props.value = 0

selectionData = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.selection.data[0]
	
	dataJSON = {
			  "ArticleNumber": selectionData.ArticleNumber,
			  "ArticleDescription": selectionData.ArticleDescription,
			  "NodeID": selectionData.LinkedNodeID,
			  "ArticleID": selectionData.ArticleID,
			  "LineID": selectionData.LineID,
			  "TubeGroup": selectionData.SawListID
			}
	
	system.perspective.openDock('ArticleDock', params = {'data': dataJSON, 'edit': 1})
